name: Bill8
tagline: Billing and payments on Sentin8 — merchants, checkout, recurring billing, a double-entry money engine, webhooks, fraud screening, and reporting as one commerce vertical.
pillarsLead: Bill8 inherits the Sentin8 security model and adds commerce guarantees — one money authority, screened charges, and signed webhook delivery.

pillars.title: One money authority
pillars.summary: Bill8:Ledger is the single authority that mutates balances; every other service moves money by asking it to post — nothing shadow-writes.

pillars.title: Screened before money moves
pillars.summary: Risk screens every charge through declarative rules and velocity checks before the payment path — fraud prevention is a gate, not a report.

pillars.title: Signed, retried webhooks
pillars.summary: Every outbound webhook is signed, persisted, and delivered with retries — merchants never miss an event silently.

pillars.title: Recurring revenue with proration
pillars.summary: Billing owns the product/price catalog, subscriptions with proration, per-cycle invoices, and metered usage — upgrades never lose a cent.

pillars.title: Payments delegated once
pillars.summary: The charge lifecycle (intent → authorize → capture → settle → refund → dispute) rides Bank8:Payment rails — bill8 never re-implements a rail.

units.name: Bill8:Payments
units.summary: The charge lifecycle: from a payment intent through authorization, capture, and settlement to refund and dispute — routed through selectable payment rails.

units.name: Bill8:Billing
units.summary: Recurring revenue: product/price catalog, subscriptions with proration, invoices generated per billing cycle, metered usage records, coupons and credits.

units.name: Bill8:Ledger
units.summary: The money engine: every money position and movement in the bill8 vertical — the single authority that mutates balances; others post through it.

units.name: Bill8:Webhooks
units.summary: The outbound integration surface: consumes domain events from Bus, materializes typed events, and delivers signed payloads to merchant-configured endpoints with retries.

units.name: Bill8:Risk
units.summary: Fraud prevention: declarative rules and velocity checks screening charges before money moves, sanctions screening, and a review queue for adjudication.

units.name: Bill8:Reporting
units.summary: The reporting surface: report types defining a query shape, report runs that execute them, and scheduled reports delivering output files via Storage.

apps.name: Bill8:Merchant
apps.summary: The operator-facing dashboard: payments, billing, connected accounts, and reporting in one merchant surface.

apps.name: Checkout
apps.summary: The payer-facing checkout app: payment method capture and charge confirmation for a single merchant transaction.

apps.name: Portal
apps.summary: The payer self-service portal: invoices, subscription management, payment methods, and history.

apps.name: Bill8 Admin
apps.summary: The staff administration surface (RFW-rendered in Dash): merchant onboarding, risk review queues, webhook monitoring.

sdks.name: bill8 Rust SDK
sdks.summary: The unified namespace facade (bill8::payments::…, bill8:billing::…) over the contracts crates — the typed integration surface for every bill8 API.

showcaseLead: Bill8 contains no platform infrastructure of its own — identity, events, storage, scheduling, and money movement are delegated.

showcase.name: Sentin8 — the platform
showcase.summary: 17 services: identity, events, storage, workflows, scheduling — everything bill8 doesn't rebuild.

showcase.name: Bank8
showcase.summary: Bill8 settlement rides Bank8:Payments — the commerce vertical delegates the rails.

eyebrow: Billing & payments for platforms on Sentin8
